VideoPress for OBS: manual installation (macOS)
===============================================

This archive is an alternative to the .pkg installer. It needs OBS Studio 31.1 or later
(Apple Silicon or Intel).

1. Quit OBS Studio.
2. Copy "obs-videopress.plugin" from this archive into:

       ~/Library/Application Support/obs-studio/plugins/

   (In Finder: Go -> Go to Folder..., paste the path; create the "plugins" folder if it
   does not exist.)

3. If this build is not signed and notarized, macOS may refuse to load it. Clear the
   download quarantine once in Terminal:

       xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Application\ Support/obs-studio/plugins/obs-videopress.plugin

4. Start OBS Studio. The VideoPress dock is under Docks -> VideoPress.

To uninstall, quit OBS and delete obs-videopress.plugin from that folder.
